scope: Four actual art failures eligible for independent repair; the dark Hess source is excluded because a same-person service hold remains. Exclusion is not qualification and does not remove it from the denominator.

decisions.display_source: Unchanged raw master with display-only white/cyan matte and nearest alpha; never game payload.
decisions.reason: Actual native original5 and full raw6dcfc623 viewed: the source short white-grey facial hair spreads across the lower chin/jaw, whereas the return reduces it to a small detached round central goatee patch below the moustache with bare yellow jaw sides. Restore only the original visible short white-grey lower-chin/jaw coverage and outline, without growing a flowing beard or placing hair where the source is smooth. Preserve actual white moustache, round glasses, sparse grey side hair, red tie, civilian clothes and opaque photo backing.

decisions.display_source: Unchanged raw master with display-only white/cyan matte and nearest alpha; never game payload.
decisions.reason: Actual native original10 and full rawbdbec97f viewed: the lower head creates a protruding chin followed by an exposed tapered yellow neck segment down to the shirt collar. Keep the original profile, pale shirt/blue patterned tie and hair, but fit a compact rounded chin directly onto a broadened and raised existing collar/shoulders, with a very short broad transition and no separate neck stalk, notch or extra yellow roll. Source lips are only subtly parted; no reliable tooth row is established, so preserve the slight mouth parting without inventing teeth or a wide open smile. Keep original backing/frame/note.

decisions.reason: Actual native original18 and full raw7f943aca viewed: the source short grey beard occupies a broader lower-chin/jaw area, while the return makes a much narrower disconnected central goatee patch. Restore the exact short grey chin/jaw outline and width actually visible in Image2, without adding a long beard or unsupported upper-cheek hair. Keep the actual grey moustache, green peaked cap/red band, uniform layers and photo backing; retain only the original small gold/dark cap fitting footprint and natural material texture without inventing a crisp star or other named device in an indistinct spot.

decisions.reason: Actual native original19 and full rawb1f1c4db viewed: the source has a distinct compact dark chin-hair patch below the mouth in addition to its dark upper-lip moustache; the return retains the moustache but leaves the chin entirely smooth yellow. Restore only the actual short dark central chin hair and original outline, without adding a full jaw beard or new sideburns. Keep actual receding hair, civilian suit, pale shirt/gold tie, expression and original opaque backing; remove new coloured specks outside the actual silhouette.
